column1: # jjstack review vocabulary — THE SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH.
# Four tools read this file and nothing else defines these names:
#   bin/jjstack-review-run-report     the per-run audit trail (not memory)
# Adding a reason code here adds it everywhere at once. Adding one anywhere
# else is a second vocabulary, which is the bug this file exists to prevent.
# Three record kinds, tab separated, `#` comments and blanks ignored:
#   effect  <name>  <ordinal>       how strongly a record may act on a finding
#   scope   <name>  <max-effect>    the ESCALATION LADDER: the narrower the key,
#                                   the stronger the verdict it may emit
#   reason  <code>  <max-effect>    the closed reason-code vocabulary, and the
#                                   strongest verdict each code may carry
# The ladder is enforced structurally, not by convention: every store validates
# reason_max). A calibration row that says `suppress` is rejected by arithmetic,
# not by anyone remembering the rule.

column4: note
recorded as history only — changes nothing about how a finding is shown
placement only — the finding stays active and keeps its own severity and confidence
filed under "Demoted (prior decision)" — still active, still printed, never dropped
taken out of the ACTIVE set — still printed and marked, with a mandatory human reason
calibration: a global pattern class. The widest key, so the weakest verdict.
ledger: a path glob plus a finding category.
baseline: one finding instance — file, line and claim content. The narrowest key, so the only one that may suppress.
the per-run report. Not memory: it records what THIS run decided and is regenerated every run.
verification could not confirm the claim at the source
a past review already ruled on this class
the evidence for the claim is thin
real, but it predates this diff
a typechecker/linter/scanner that actually ran already covers it
pure style, not called out in a CLAUDE.md
could not be reproduced
the same defect is already accounted for elsewhere
unreachable today is reachable after the next refactor — deprioritise, never delete
a human accepted the risk on the record
retired by the committed baseline with its own stated reason
disproved against current official documentation (Phase 4.5b) — bound exclusively to the `refuted` disposition, which is the only "this finding is WRONG" outcome
